editorial: Stepping into that snow‑blanketed cabin feels like diving into a carefully engineered labyrinth that will test every sense of the self. The film turns Chris’s high‑tech retreat into a living, breathing architectural nightmare that follows you on every shift of light and shadow. In a tense showdown moment, the steady‑cam glides through a claustrophobic corridor so smoothly it feels like a heartbeat you can't ignore. You’ll find the slow‑burn discovery of motives rewarding, especially if you relish psychological tension over predictable beats. The pacing lurches a little late in the second half, letting the suspense last longer than it warranted.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
